title: GIA – Agriculture & soil conservation
summary: Training, seed, and demonstration for SC farmers; honey bee keeping, sericulture, commercial crops.
nextStep: Ask the district Social Welfare / SC corporation to include you in the state's PM-AJAY GIA perspective plan.

title: GIA – Horticulture
summary: Fruit and vegetable plantation, small nurseries, marketing of produce.
nextStep: Village horticulture + PM-AJAY GIA income-generation project via State SC corporation.

title: GIA – Animal husbandry
summary: Dairy, goat, poultry, milk, livestock units for SC families with training.
nextStep: Combine NSQF dairy/goat course with NSFDC micro-loan for animals.

title: GIA – Minor irrigation
summary: Dug wells, pump sets, farm ponds, drip for SC cultivators.
nextStep: District agriculture + PM-AJAY GIA infrastructure/income project.

title: GIA – Skill development training
summary: NSQF-aligned short and long courses under GIA. States must show ~70% wage or self-employment after training.
nextStep: Register interest through the PM-AJAY portal / State SC corporation. Do not enrol in PM-DAKSH for the same skill slot.

title: PM-DAKSH short-term training
summary: Free NSQF training for SC (18–45, no income cap). Stipend during STT. Mutually exclusive with PM-AJAY skill for the same person.
nextStep: Register on Skill India Digital Hub, then pmdaksh.dosje.gov.in.

title: PM Vishwakarma (traditional trades)
summary: 18 traditional trades: darzi, badhai, lohar, nai, kumhar, sunar, cobbler and others. Toolkit + training + credit.
nextStep: Apply via PM Vishwakarma portal through CSC / common service centre.

title: NSFDC Micro Finance Scheme
summary: Loan up to ₹1.25 lakh (90% of project up to ₹1.40 lakh) at 6.5% for the beneficiary. 3-year repayment.
nextStep: Apply through the State Channelizing Agency (SC SC development corporation), not directly to NSFDC.

title: NSFDC Term Loan
summary: Projects above ₹1.40 lakh up to ₹50 lakh. NSFDC share up to 90%. Interest 6–10% to beneficiary by slab.
nextStep: Prepare a simple project with the State Channelizing Agency. Annual family income ceiling applies.

title: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (NSFDC)
summary: Concessional micro-credit for SC women micro-enterprises.
nextStep: Women SHG / SCA window of the State SC corporation.

title: NSFDC Green Business Scheme
summary: Credit for climate-friendly livelihoods such as solar products, e-rickshaw, waste.
nextStep: SCA application with a green activity proposal.

title: Enrol and get NSQF certificate on SIDH
summary: Skill India Digital Hub is the national enrolment, assessment and certificate DPI. Certificates go to DigiLocker.
nextStep: Create SIDH profile after counselling. Search courses by district.

title: Register on National Career Service
summary: NCS lists public and private vacancies. Linked with e-Shram for informal workers.
nextStep: After skilling, create NCS jobseeker profile; also e-Shram if informal worker.

title: e-Shram + NCS job match
summary: Universal account for informal workers; NCS uses it to surface nearby jobs.
nextStep: Register on eshram.gov.in if not already, then search NCS nearby jobs.
